root_cause.text: In csio_eh_lun_reset_handler, when rn is NULL, the error exit path jumps to the 'fail' label which unconditionally dereferences rn via the CSIO_INC_STATS macro, causing a null pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a new label 'fail_ret' that bypasses the CSIO_INC_STATS(rn, ...) call, and changes the early-exit goto from 'fail' to 'fail_ret' when rn is NULL. This confirms that the original code would call CSIO_INC_STATS with a NULL rn pointer.
